name: Term
job: Explain a word at first use without a lookup.
description: The term, then a compact gloss set in the same line.

name: Sparkline
job: Show the shape of a small series inside a sentence.
description: A word-sized line that always states its first and last value.

name: KeyChord
job: Tell the reader what to press.
description: Keycaps joined by plus for together and then for in sequence.

name: Literal
job: Keep an exact identifier exact.
description: Monospace for names where case and punctuation matter.

name: DatedValue
job: Stop an old number from reading as current.
description: A value with the date it was true attached to it.

name: StageGlyph
job: Say how far along something is.
description: A glyph that fills by stage, always beside its word.

name: Marker
job: Tie a place in a figure to the sentence about it.
description: A small numbered dot used in both places.

name: DropCap
job: Mark where a piece begins.
description: An opening paragraph with a raised initial.

name: Kicker
job: Say what kind of thing this is before the headline.
description: A small sentence-case line above the title.

name: Playback
job: Let a reader pause anything that moves on its own.
description: A play and pause button with one dot per step.

name: Choice
job: Pick one of a few options in a figure.
description: A row of native radios styled as a segmented control.

name: Range
job: Change one number in a figure.
description: A native slider with its value written beside it.

name: Action
job: Do the one thing a figure is about.
description: A small button in a quiet or strong tone.

name: Figure
job: Show something and say what to notice.
description: A body, an automatic number, a full-sentence caption and a credit.

name: MarginNote
job: Keep a tangent near the sentence it belongs to.
description: A numbered note in the margin that folds under its paragraph on a narrow page.

name: Aside
job: Set a small block beside a section.
description: A margin block for a fact sheet, a small figure or a note.

name: PullQuote
job: Give a second way into the piece.
description: One sentence from the body, enlarged, with a link back to its context.

name: Abstract
job: State the whole piece before the body.
description: Two or three sentences set apart, like a paper's abstract.

name: FactSheet
job: Describe one thing through named properties.
description: Aligned label and value pairs that stack in a margin.

name: CodeBlock
job: Show real code and explain the lines that matter.
description: A listing with its file path, line numbers, marked lines and notes beside them.

name: Terminal
job: Separate what a reader types from what comes back.
description: A transcript where typed lines and output look different.

name: FileTree
job: Show where things live.
description: Folders and files with connectors, notes and a marked entry.

name: SourceResult
job: Show a small input becoming a visible output.
description: The literal source beside what it renders to.

name: Compare
job: Set two things with a shared frame side by side.
description: Two labelled columns under matching rules.

name: Ledger
job: Lay out a decision with its costs.
description: Aligned rows of constraint, choice and cost that stack on a narrow page.

name: Procedure
job: Give steps whose order matters.
description: Numbered actions ending in a check the reader can see.

name: Pipeline
job: Show the stages something moves through.
description: Boxes in order with one line each, across or down as space allows.

name: Chronoline
job: Make unequal gaps in time look unequal.
description: Numbered events on a measured scale with a key underneath.

name: BarList
job: Compare a few magnitudes.
description: Bars from a shared zero with each number written out.

name: Citation
job: Keep a claim and its source distinct.
description: The claim with its named source set directly beneath.

name: Article
job: Hold a piece of writing.
description: A reading column with a margin, numbering figures and notes automatically.

name: ArticleHeader
job: Open the piece.
description: Kicker, headline, deck and a ruled byline.

name: Explorable
job: Let a reader poke a small working model.
description: A stage, a few controls and a sentence that changes with them.

name: CodeWalkthrough
job: Walk through a listing a few lines at a time.
description: Code beside steps that mark their lines, advancing on their own with a pause control.

name: StatusReport
job: End honestly.
description: What works today, what does not yet, and where to get it.
